title: Upgrades packages.
body:
----

**Note:** This PR includes upgrades to packages, and fixes for all the warnings/errors produced by updated eslint.

Ian decided that the strategy to be followed was to suppress these new warnings, to avoid combining dependency updates and extensive code changes in one PR.

The dependency update & suppression is going to happen in another PR, and we'll keep this one as a reference for what code fixes are required.

comments.body:
That's a strange one. 

Will be on it in the morning.
@sandro768  - could you remind me/us of the command you're running which produces that error, and branch that you're in please?

Aah, sorry - I didn't spot this earlier.  Could you re-run `yarn build` first?

We need to run that before `yarn develop` (says the man who barely understands the build process ;-) ).
`yarn build` fixes it. Maybe we need to update the readme

Sure - how about submitting a PR that fixes the readme? (you can do it from GitHub website - just open the `readme.md` and click on the `edit` toolbar button).  You can include `fixes #678` in the PR description.  When we close it, it will close this too.
